newsitem.title: USA: Nevada Manhattan options Amazon timberland.
newsitem.headline: Nevada Manhattan options Amazon timberland.

text.p: Nevada Manhattan Mining Inc said Tuesday it has optioned an additional 420,000 hectares (1,770 square miles) of virgin timberland in Brazil.

The company said in a statement that much of the land is contiguous to the previously reported 280,000 hectares of accessible virgin, hardwood timberland on the Amazon River, in Para, Brazil. In January Nevada Manhattan said its 80 percent owned subsidiary Equatorial Resources had begin timber production in the area.
The company said market evaluation on a sample of its holdings on the 700,000 hectares indicated potential yield of 200 cubic meters per hectare of hardwood timber.
The company said net selling prices will be about $500 per cubic meter with profits expected at $200 per cubic meter.

Production of 2,500 cubic meters per month is estimated to begin next month. Nevada also said it will immediately proceed with its expansion plans to raise its production to 30,000 cubic meters per month by the fall of 1997.
